column3: The Hebrew says forty-two years old and calls Athaliah Omri’s daughter; BSB says twenty-two and calls her Omri’s granddaughter.
The Hebrew says “he”; BSB names Ahaziah.
The Hebrew names the visiting king Azariah and calls Joram sick; BSB names the visitor Ahaziah and describes Joram as wounded.

The Hebrew leaves the searcher unnamed and uses unnamed plural subjects for capturing, bringing, and killing him; BSB names Jehu, specifies his soldiers, and uses passives. The Hebrew calls him Jehoshaphat’s son; BSB says grandson.
The Hebrew says “all the seed of the kingdom”; BSB says “all the royal heirs.”
The Hebrew says she did not kill him; BSB says she could not kill him.
The Hebrew leaves the hidden person unnamed here; BSB names Joash.
